content.title: Home of Purdue, Welcome to Lafayette-West Lafayette, Indiana
content.text: Welcome to Welcome to Lafayette-West Lafayette, Indiana, home of Purdue University. Located along the scenic Wabash River, our twin cities offer a perfect blend of rich history, modern attractions, and the energy of Purdue University. Whether you're strolling through historic downtown Lafayette, enjoying local art and culture, or exploring outdoor trails along the river, there's something for everyone here. Click on the titles to discover the attractions and experiences our different areas have to offer. Welcome to Lafayette Immerse yourself in the local culture by visiting historic sites and engaging with our thriving arts scene, featuring galleries, theaters, and community events that celebrate creativity. Whether you're enjoying a day outdoors, exploring unique shops, or attending a local festival, the Lafayette area offers something for everyone. Experience the warmth and hospitality that make our community truly special. LEARN MORE Welcome To West Lafayette West Lafayette is a vibrant and welcoming city known for being home to Purdue University, a world-renowned institution that brings energy, innovation, and cultural diversity to the area. Nestled along the Wabash River, West Lafayette offers a blend of small-town charm and academic spirit, with scenic parks, engaging arts and entertainment, and a lively food scene. Whether you're exploring the university campus, enjoying the outdoors, or attending a local event, West Lafayette delivers a dynamic experience for residents and visitors alike. Read More Purdue University Purdue University, founded in 1869, is a top-tier research institution known for innovation in science, engineering, and beyond. With over 50,000 students, Big Ten athletics, and 1,000+ student organizations, campus life is vibrant and welcoming. Located near the Wabash River and downtown Lafayette, Purdue offers a beautiful, walkable campus full of energy and tradition. Whether visiting for a tour, a game, or an event, Purdue blends academic excellence with Midwestern charm—Boiler Up! Read More Welcome to DOWNTOWN Explore the charming Chauncey Village, known for its eclectic mix of boutiques and eateries that cater to every taste. Stroll along the picturesque Riverfront Wabash, where scenic views and recreational activities await. Don’t miss the Arts and Market district, home to local artisans, galleries, and events that celebrate creativity and innovation. Immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere that makes our downtown a unique destination for visitors and locals alike. LEARN MORE Welcome to BATTLE GROUND Explore Battle Ground, which seamlessly blends small-town charm with breathtaking natural beauty! At the heart of the community lies Prophetstown State Park, where you can hike scenic trails, enjoy picnics, and immerse yourself in the diverse wildlife of the area. Uncover the park’s historical exhibits that celebrate the region's rich cultural heritage. Experience the warm community spirit and picturesque landscapes that make this area a delightful destination for all. LEARN MORE
